general_information.Description: This course is designed based on the Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK) course. The Cloud Security course is designed for Cisco Networking Academy® students who will learn the fundamentals of cloud computing and prepare for the Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK). The CCSK certificate is widely recognized as the standard of expertise for cloud security and gives you a cohesive and vendor-neutral understanding of how to secure data in the cloud.
general_information.StudentTasks: Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Students are responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information - Students must complete all assignments on the Cisco Networking Academy (https://www.netacad.com/) with a result of at least 75%.
general_information.Tools: c) Tools: Baseline Equipment Bundle: - PCs - Internet connection for lab and student PCs Student PC Software: - Accessed online with no special equipment or system requirements
general_information.Note: There are no prerequisites for this offering. Learners are expected to have the following skills: - High school reading level - Basic computer literacy - Basic PC operating system navigation skills - Basic internet usage skills

description: This course is designed based on the Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK) course. The Cloud Security course is designed for Cisco Networking Academy® students who will learn the fundamentals of cloud computing and prepare for the Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK). The CCSK certificate is widely recognized as the standard of expertise for cloud security and gives you a cohesive and vendor-neutral understanding of how to secure data in the cloud.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Explain the employment opportunities by filling the skills-gap for cloud-certified professionals.
Explain the competency in key cloud security issues through an organization that specializes in cloud research.
Demonstrate for students technical knowledge, skills, and abilities to effectively use controls tailored to the cloud.
Understand how to establish a baseline of security best practices when dealing with a broad array of responsibilities, from cloud governance to configuring technical security controls.
Recognize the behavior-based approach to cloud security and interest in cloud security.
Understand legal and ethical issues in cloud security.
Explain the opportunities for pursuing an education and a career in cloud security.
Evaluate cloud security risks in an industry sector
Use industry-standard models to explain security requirements in Cloud computing.
Explain in-depth understanding of the full capabilities of cloud computing.
Evaluate to effectively develop a holistic cloud security program relative to globally accepted standards
Evaluate best practices for Identity and Access Management (IAM), cloud incident response, application security, data encryption, Security as a Service, and securing emerging technologies.
Apply security threats and best practices for securing the cloud
